items.summary: Remove or relax the admin-only authorization guard on the 'addHomeStay' (or equivalent) backend function so that authenticated users (including partners and non-admin authenticated principals) can successfully create and save homestay listings without receiving an 'Unauthorized: Only authenticated admins can add homestays' error.

Update the HomeStayManagement frontend component to remove any client-side admin-only guard or error handling that blocks non-admin authenticated users from submitting the add-homestay form, ensuring the form submission reaches the backend for all authenticated users.
